title: REALISTIC CLOUDS
body:
This resource pack transforms Minecraft’s sky into a soft, atmospheric, and dynamic cloudscape, bringing a smoother and more immersive look to your world. Inspired by the beautiful aesthetic of [SoftyClouds](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/softyclouds), this pack builds on that gentle style while adding its own unique touches.

☁️ Features
Soft volumetric‑style clouds  
Smooth, layered cloud formations that feel natural and visually calming.

Dynamic cloud shading  
Clouds subtly react to lighting, fog, and distance, creating a more atmospheric sky.

Weather‑responsive clouds

Clouds darken during rain

Become dramatically darker during thunderstorms

Lightning strikes produce bright, momentary flashes across the sky

Lightweight and performance‑friendly  
Designed to look good without tanking your FPS.

Enhanced ambience  
Works beautifully with sunsets, sunrises, and fog‑heavy biomes.

🎨 Inspired by SoftyClouds
This pack takes clear inspiration from the soft, dreamy aesthetic of SoftyClouds, aiming to deliver a similar cozy atmosphere while introducing new behaviors and visual effects.
